segments.sensitive: Two reviewers describe the patches as gentle and safe for sensitive skin, with one noting no irritation and softer skin after removal.
segments.mature: One reviewer using the patches for menopause-related acne reports visibly reduced breakouts by morning.

concerns.spots: Most reviewers report visible flattening or disappearance of individual spots within hours to a couple of days, including overnight results before school or work; a minority say the medicine does nothing and one describes a pimple bleeding and worsening after removal.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers say the patches stop them from picking at blemishes and help breakouts clear faster than other patches or drugstore brands, though one reviewer says a breakout stayed the same or got worse over a week of daily use.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers note the patches calm or reduce redness around a spot, while one reviewer reports the opposite, saying the area turned bright red after removal.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer credits the patches with keeping pores clear and preventing enlargement, though this is an isolated report.

extraits.texte: These literally don't do anything. If anything, they're just a sticker to cover your pimples so people can't see them, but they don't actually shrink the pimple. I've used them on pimples with whiteheads, which people on the internet say that pimple patches are good for. They supposedly don't do anything for pimples with no whitehead. In my experience, they do nothing for ANY type of pimple. Waste of money unless you're just buying these to hide your pimples.

extraits.titre: Cute but doesn't work at all
extraits.texte: I like how cute these are! They are perfect for hiding pimples and they really stay stuck as long as you want until you have the really pry them off your face. So my only downside is that they don't work. Like the medicine in it does nothing. If anything, it makes then worse and bright red when I take them off. I've used them daily on the only pimple I have and it's still the same or worse than it was a week ago!
Love the stars! I am dealing with menopause acne and these do the trick. I put them on before bed and the next morning my acne is significantly less. Highly recommend!
